name: where-used
ground_truth_source: grep fallback of story 2.7 (crates/sem-core/tests/fixtures/abap/inside-sap/whereused.grep.json, converted by scripts/abap-whereused-convert.py); point this at ground_truth/whereused.json once the sapcli export exists
